q: The Fourier transform on L²(ℝ) is a unitary isometry (Parseval's theorem). For f, g ∈ L²(ℝ):
opts: f̂ ∈ L¹ for all f ∈ L²
exp: Plancherel theorem: ||f̂||₂ = ||f||₂ (with appropriate normalization). The Fourier transform extends to a unitary operator on L²(ℝ). The L² theory requires extension from L¹ ∩ L² by density, unlike the L¹ case where the Fourier transform is defined directly.
